blocks.heading: Foreign Degree Genuinely Moves the Needle

items.text: A handful of sectors treat a foreign degree, especially from a globally recognised university, as a real and active hiring filter, not just a nice-to-have line on a resume.
Firms such as McKinsey, BCG, and Bain actively recruit Indian graduates from top international business schools and universities, alongside domestic feeders like the IIMs, ISB, XLRI, and FMS.
Front-office roles at global banks and funds still lean heavily on target-school recruiting pipelines built over decades.

blocks.heading: Skills-First Shift Changing the Whole Calculation

items.text: The bigger story for anyone weighing this decision right now is not foreign versus domestic, it is degree versus skill.

This shift is strongest in technology, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity, precisely the fields where hands-on, verifiable ability is easiest to test directly through coding challenges, portfolios, and take-home assignments.

If your target field is skills-first, most of tech, product, design, analytics, marketing, and growing parts of finance, spending a large amount on a foreign degree purely to improve how a recruiter perceives your resume is a weak trade.
